candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that sets acc.unlockTime so that it remains its default value of 0.
Change acc.unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the parameter.
Change the balance update from add_uint256 to a plain addition so that overflow/wrapping can occur, altering the stored balance.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier to allow reentrant calls that may affect state updates during Put execution.
Change nonReentrant_ modifier to not set locked_ to false after execution, permanently locking affected functions after first call.
Remove the require check in nonReentrant_ so that reentrancy is never prevented.
Delete the require that checks locked_ in the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrant calls to Collect.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from the Collect function, enabling reentrancy during collect.
Set locked_ back to false before the external call, breaking reentrancy protection.
Remove the unlocked time check so Collect succeeds even when funds are still locked.
Change the external call to transfer which stops on failure, altering balance reduction in failure cases.
Move the balance subtraction before the external call, enabling reentrancy with reduced balance already recorded.
